name: Acceptance narrator
description: The acceptance run's plain plugin with `voices.use`: its `narrate` command asks the run's tone voice to say a line and gets the audio back as its own data (nothing plays). Its child, `nosy`, has no `voices.use`: the same ask is refused.

commands.name: narrate
commands.description: Asks the run's tone voice to say a line; answers with the bytes it got.
